`PK_Choosing_Metric_public.Rmd` is a private R Markdown file holding four
questions to work through when choosing an exposure metric for an
exposure-response analysis. It becomes
[Selecting an Exposure Metric](../../selecting-an-exposure-metric.qmd) on the
PMX Tools page. The conversion is done; one figure is missing.

## Documents

- [Working specification](specification.qmd). What the source file holds, what
  changed in the conversion, and what is left.
- [References](references.qmd). The two papers the page cites, and a marker on
  each recording whether the page's use of it has been checked against the
  source.
